transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started. Before I issue our binding response strategy for the week, I want to make sure we're all on the same page. We've got the putative consumer class action over the referral program marketing, 480 users in the putative class, and the possibility of pushing users into arbitration based on the user agreement provisions. We've also floated a limited injunction on the referral program as a potential resolution. I need to hear from each of you on discovery status and any client business constraints I should be aware of before I lock in our strategy. Who wants to start?

While reconciling a late-produced onboarding export against the user-agreement database, I confirmed that only 312 of the 480 putative class members have executed agreements containing an arbitration provision. The other 168 do not have arbitration clauses. I haven't yet incorporated this reconciliation into the arbitration analysis, but this directly affects our ability to compel arbitration for the entire putative class.
